contracts.id: Red Newspaper: Masthead Header->Red Newspaper: Article Grid
contracts.payload: { query: string /* trimmed search term; empty string means no search filter */ }

contracts.id: Red Newspaper: Category Navigation Bar->Red Newspaper: Article Grid
contracts.payload: { categoryId: string /* e.g. 'world' | 'politics' | 'business' | 'sports' | 'culture' | 'opinion' | 'tech' | 'science' | 'health' | 'travel' | 'obituaries' | 'crossword' */; label: string /* display label, e.g. 'World' */ }

contracts.id: Red Newspaper: Category Navigation Bar->Red Newspaper: Sidebar Most Read Panel
contracts.payload: { categoryId: string /* e.g. 'world' | 'politics' | 'business' | 'sports' | 'culture' | 'opinion' | 'tech' | 'science' | 'health' | 'travel' | 'obituaries' | 'crossword' */; label: string /* display label, e.g. 'World' */ }

contracts.id: Red Newspaper: Breaking News Ticker->Red Newspaper: Lead Story Feature
contracts.payload: { id: string; headline: string; dek: string /* short summary, may be empty */; byline: string /* e.g. 'By M. Halloran' */; tag: string /* section label, uppercase e.g. 'WORLD' */; imageUrl: string /* absolute URL, empty string if none */; imageCaption: string; body: string[] /* article paragraphs */; timestamp: string /* 'HH:MM' filed time */; breaking: boolean } | null

example.headline: Tech giant confirms acquisition of rival chip designer for $41B
example.dek: The deal would consolidate two of the largest designers in the sector.
example.imageCaption: Wafer inspection at the company's northern fabrication plant.
body: Executives confirmed the agreement in a filing released before markets opened.
Regulators in three jurisdictions are expected to review the transaction.

contracts.id: Red Newspaper: Article Grid->Red Newspaper: Lead Story Feature
contracts.payload: { id: string; headline: string; dek: string; byline: string /* e.g. 'By M. Halloran' */; tag: string /* section label, uppercase e.g. 'WORLD' */; imageUrl: string /* absolute URL, empty string if none */; imageCaption: string; body: string[] /* article paragraphs */; timestamp: string /* 'HH:MM' filed time */; breaking: boolean } | null

example.headline: Copper Surges to a Four-Year High
example.dek: Supply constraints in the southern belt pushed contracts past the previous ceiling.
example.imageCaption: Cathode sheets stacked at a southern smelter.
body: Prices climbed through the session as inventories fell to multi-year lows.
Analysts expect the squeeze to ease only after the next shipping cycle.

contracts.id: Red Newspaper: Sidebar Most Read Panel->Red Newspaper: Lead Story Feature
contracts.payload: { id: string; headline: string; dek: string; byline: string; tag: string /* section label, uppercase e.g. 'WORLD' */; imageUrl: string /* absolute URL, empty string if none */; imageCaption: string; body: string[] /* article paragraphs */; timestamp: string /* 'HH:MM' filed time */; breaking: boolean; rank: number /* 1-based position in most-read list */; metric: string /* e.g. '298K views' */ } | null

example.headline: Inside the Harbor Deal That Redrew a Coastline
example.dek: A decade of quiet negotiation reshaped forty kilometres of shoreline.
body: The agreement was signed without public hearings.
Residents learned of the plan only after dredging began.

channelList.id: Red Newspaper: Masthead Header->Red Newspaper: Article Grid
channelList.description: When the reader types a keyword into the masthead search field and submits, emit the query string; the Article Grid re-queries its story list and re-renders only articles whose headline, dek, or body matches the term, showing a 'results for X' state.

channelList.id: Red Newspaper: Category Navigation Bar->Red Newspaper: Article Grid
channelList.description: When the reader clicks a section tab, emit the selected category id; the Article Grid filters and re-renders to show only stories tagged with that section and marks the tab as active.

channelList.id: Red Newspaper: Category Navigation Bar->Red Newspaper: Sidebar Most Read Panel
channelList.to: Red Newspaper: Sidebar Most Read Panel
channelList.description: When the reader clicks a section tab, emit the selected category id; the Most Read panel refreshes its ranked list to the most-read stories within that section.

channelList.id: Red Newspaper: Breaking News Ticker->Red Newspaper: Lead Story Feature
channelList.description: When the reader clicks a scrolling breaking headline, emit that article's id and payload; the Lead Story Feature replaces its current content with the selected breaking story's headline, image, and body.

channelList.id: Red Newspaper: Article Grid->Red Newspaper: Lead Story Feature
channelList.description: When the reader clicks a story card, emit that article's id and full payload; the Lead Story Feature loads and displays the selected article.

channelList.id: Red Newspaper: Sidebar Most Read Panel->Red Newspaper: Lead Story Feature
channelList.from: Red Newspaper: Sidebar Most Read Panel
channelList.description: When the reader clicks a ranked headline, emit that article's id and payload; the Lead Story Feature loads and displays the selected story.
